rawSource.name: American Pocket Shark
rawSource.description: Besides clusters of photophores on its body, it has two pockets near its gills that secrete a luminous fluid.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Angular Roughshark
rawSource.description: It has a wide pink snout, massive nostrils, and pronounced dermal denticles, giving it a furry, pig-like appearance.

abilityText.raw: [Discard] also, if [BlueCoral][BlueCoral][BlueCoral] in this dive site: [DrawCard]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Armored Searobin
rawSource.ability: [Discard] also, if [BlueCoral][BlueCoral][BlueCoral] in this dive site: [DrawCard]
rawSource.description: The armored searobin's body is completely covered in a heavy plating composed of four rows of bony spiny scales.

abilityText.raw: [FishHatch] also, if [GreenCoral][GreenCoral][GreenCoral] in this dive site: [FishEgg]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Atlantic Thornyhead
rawSource.ability: [FishHatch] also, if [GreenCoral][GreenCoral][GreenCoral] in this dive site: [FishEgg]
rawSource.description: The Atlantic thornyhead has a spined ridge between its eyes as well as spines along its back.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Basking Shark
rawSource.description: A filter feeder and the second-largest known living fish, the basking shark can be found in all temperate oceans.

abilityText.raw: [FreePlayFishFromHand] if no [AnyCoral] in this fish's dive site

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Blackmouth Angler
rawSource.ability: [FreePlayFishFromHand] if no [AnyCoral] in this fish's dive site
rawSource.description: The blackmouth angler hides in the mud or sand and uses its fleshy lure to ambush prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Blacktip Shark
rawSource.description: A fast, active swimmer, it sometimes makes spinning leaps out of the water when hunting schooling fishes.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Blue Shark
rawSource.description: Female blue sharks birth from 4 to over 100 pups per litter, each 35 to 50 cm in length, in nursery areas found offshore.

abilityText.raw: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [ConsumeFish1]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Bluering Angelfish
rawSource.ability: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [ConsumeFish1]
rawSource.description: The bluering angelfish's Latin name means “ringed,” which refers to the small ring on its body above the gill cover.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Bonnethead Shark
rawSource.description: The only shark species known to be omnivorous, its diet includes crustaceans, mollusks, small fish, and seagrass.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Broadnose Sevengill Shark
rawSource.description: Alongside the sharpnose sevengill (Heptranchias perlo), it's listed in the Guinness World Records as the fish with the most gill slits.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Common Bluestripe Snapper
rawSource.description: It has a varied diet, feeding on fishes, shrimps, crabs, and crustaceans, as well as plant and algae material.

abilityText.raw: [FishHatch] also, if [GreenCoral][GreenCoral][GreenCoral] in this dive site: [Discard]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Daggertooth
rawSource.ability: [FishHatch] also, if [GreenCoral][GreenCoral][GreenCoral] in this dive site: [Discard]
rawSource.description: Older daggertooth appear to turn black, lose their teeth, and migrate to deeper waters, possibly to reproduce.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Dusky Shark
rawSource.description: It migrates hundreds to thousands of km to temperate waters in the summer and toward the equator in the winter.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Dwarf Lanternshark
rawSource.description: One of the smallest known sharks, the dwarf lanternshark's bioluminescent belly helps it blend in with sunlight from above.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Epaulette Shark
rawSource.description: It can swim, but it mostly “walks” along coral reefs on its fins. It can even travel short distances over land.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Filetail Catshark
rawSource.description: This catshark's common name comes from the toothlike projections on its skin.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Fire Dartfish
rawSource.description: It usually hovers above its burrow, quick to dart inside. It flicks its long dorsal fin back and forth, perhaps as a signal.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Flame Angelfish
rawSource.description: The male fish are slightly larger than the females, and the blue streaks along the fins are more apparent.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Foxface Rabbitfish
rawSource.description: During nighttime or when stressed, the foxface rabbitfish changes to a duller, mottled pattern that's harder to see.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Frilled Shark
rawSource.description: It moves like an eel, capturing prey whole with flexible jaws that are lined with bunches of recurved trident-like teeth.

abilityText.raw: [Discard] also, if [BlueCoral][BlueCoral][BlueCoral] in this dive site: [SchoolFeederMove]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Furry Coffinfish
rawSource.ability: [Discard] also, if [BlueCoral][BlueCoral][BlueCoral] in this dive site: [SchoolFeederMove]
rawSource.description: It can increase its size up to 30% by inflating its body with water and holding its breath up to four minutes.

abilityText.raw: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [SchoolFeederMove]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Ghostly Seadevil
rawSource.ability: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [SchoolFeederMove]
rawSource.description: Instead of a lure, this translucent anglerfish uses a small bioluminescent skin flap to attract prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Giant Moray
rawSource.description: Sheltering by day in crevices up to 50 meters deep, this nocturnal ambush predator hunts primarily by smell.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Goblin Shark
rawSource.description: A sluggish swimmer, it can dramatically extend its specialized protrusible jaws to quickly capture nearby prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Great Barracuda
rawSource.description: Its long, prominent teeth fit into pockets on the opposing jaw, allowing it to close its mouth, locking onto its prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Great Hammerhead
rawSource.description: Its unmistakably shaped head provides stereoscopic vision and improves electromagnetic signal detection.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Gray Reef Shark
rawSource.description: Fast, agile, and social, they form schools near coral reef drop-offs, but these groups disperse at night.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Gulper Shark
rawSource.description: A slender dogfish with two spined dorsal fins and large, green eyes, it typically hunts along the ocean's bottom.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Indian Sail-fin Surgeonfish
rawSource.description: At night its skin becomes paler and more uniform in response to the darkness, helping it to pass unnoticed.

abilityText.raw: [Discard] also, if [BlueCoral][BlueCoral][BlueCoral] in this dive site: [FishHatch]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Jensen's Skate
rawSource.ability: [Discard] also, if [BlueCoral][BlueCoral][BlueCoral] in this dive site: [FishHatch]
rawSource.description: Named in honor of Danish zoologist, Adolf Severin Jensen, this skate has been found at depths over 2,500 meters.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Kitefin Shark
rawSource.description: The largest known shark that exhibits bioluminescence, it hunts mostly deep-sea fishes, including other sharks and rays.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Lemon Shark
rawSource.description: This sociable shark's brain has the relative mass of a bird's. Its pups may remain for years in the same nursery grounds.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Leopard Shark
rawSource.description: Common in shallow, intertidal waters and kelp forests, the leopard shark often forages in large nomadic schools.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Lollipop Catshark
rawSource.description: Its body is soft, almost gelatinous. Its head contains unusually large gills, allowing it to survive in low-oxygen habitats.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Longnose Hawkfish
rawSource.description: It's often seen perched, camouflaged, on a red gorgonian sea fan, waiting to make a short, fast rush at its prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Malabar Grouper
rawSource.description: Found in tropical estuaries and around coastal coral and rocky reefs, it preys on fish, crustaceans, and occasionally cephalopods.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Megamouth Shark
rawSource.description: Only around 200 specimens have been observed or caught. It swims with its mouth wide open, filtering water for plankton and jellyfish.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Mimic Goatfish
rawSource.description: It can mimic the coloration of the bluestripe snapper (Lutjanus kasmira) with which it is often found in schools.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Moorish Idol
rawSource.description: Its genus name, Zanclus, comes from the Greek word for “sickle” and refers to the long sickle-shaped dorsal fin.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Ninja Lanternshark
rawSource.description: A young cousin of the researcher who identified it suggested its common name, pointing out that “ninjas are awesome.”

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Nurse Shark
rawSource.description: Found in coral reefs and shallow waters, this bottom-feeder can generate incredible suction with its mouth.

abilityText.raw: [Discard] also, if [BlueCoral][BlueCoral][BlueCoral] in this dive site: [FishEgg]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Owlfish
rawSource.ability: [Discard] also, if [BlueCoral][BlueCoral][BlueCoral] in this dive site: [FishEgg]
rawSource.description: It is characterized by its large eyes (compared to its body size), which allow it to see in the dim light of the deep ocean.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Portuguese Dogfish
rawSource.description: Its acute vision is optimized to detect small prey, but it has been known to take bites out of live seals and even whales.

abilityText.raw: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [DrawCard]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Prickly Anglerfish
rawSource.ability: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [DrawCard]
rawSource.description: This deep-sea fish has a bioluminescent lure to attract prey, and it has spikes all over its body to help ward off predators.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Red-lipped Batfish
rawSource.description: It “walks” along the sandy bottom of a reef or the ocean floor. Its bright red mouth has the appearance of wearing lipstick.

abilityText.raw: [FishFromHand][ArrowDown][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral] (in a dive site with at least 3)

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Reef Triggerfish
rawSource.ability: [FishFromHand][ArrowDown][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral] (in a dive site with at least 3)
rawSource.description: Called humuhumunukunukuapua'a in Hawaiian (or just humuhumu for short), it is the state fish of Hawaii.

abilityText.raw: [FishHatch] also, if [GreenCoral][GreenCoral][GreenCoral] in this dive site: [DrawCard]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Ribbon Sawtail Fish
rawSource.ability: [FishHatch] also, if [GreenCoral][GreenCoral][GreenCoral] in this dive site: [DrawCard]
rawSource.description: It has photophores along its body and a bioluminescent lure. The larval form has eyes on long, periscopic stalks.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Ribboned Sweetlips
rawSource.description: As its common name suggests, this fish has fleshy lips. The inside of its mouth is bright red, and its chin is white.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Rose-veiled Fairy Wrasse
rawSource.description: When seen in the dark, it appears deep purple with gleaming pink around its head and throughout its fins.

abilityText.raw: [FishHatch] also, if [GreenCoral][GreenCoral][GreenCoral] in this dive site: [FishFromHandConsume]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Rough Abyssal Grenadier
rawSource.ability: [FishHatch] also, if [GreenCoral][GreenCoral][GreenCoral] in this dive site: [FishFromHandConsume]
rawSource.description: It has an oxygen-filled swim bladder, rare for deep-sea fish, for bouyancy at the extreme depths it inhabits.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Roving Coral Grouper
rawSource.description: It is known to occasionally engage in cooperative hunting, teaming up with the giant moray (Gymnothorax javanicus).

abilityText.raw: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [FishHatch]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Sablefish
rawSource.ability: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [FishHatch]
rawSource.description: The sablefish spawns multiple times in a season, and it has a maximum recorded age of 94 years.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Sand Tiger Shark
rawSource.description: Not a close relative of the tiger shark, it is the only shark known to store air in its body to maintain neutral buoyancy.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Sarcastic Fringehead
rawSource.description: Males “wrestle” to establish territorial dominance, pressing their distended mouths against each other.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Shortfin Mako
rawSource.description: One of only five species of sharks known to have warm blood, several degrees warmer than the surrounding water.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Shortnose Demon Catshark
rawSource.description: Most deepwater catsharks lay egg cases with long tendrils at the corners that help attach them to the seafloor.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Sixgill Sawshark
rawSource.description: It hunts using its two sensitive barbels and electric sense, incapacitating prey with a rostrum that is edged with teeth.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Spotted Scat
rawSource.description: This fish can sting with dorsal and ventral fin spines, inflicting a venom that causes great pain and dizziness for humans.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Spotted Wobbegong
rawSource.description: They sometimes gather in distinct social groups, not randomly or according to the amount of food available.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Starry Pipefish
rawSource.description: Like the seahorses they resemble, female pipefish deposit partial clutches into the male's brood pouch to gestate.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Stellate Puffer
rawSource.description: In addition to being able to inflate its body, it protects itself by ingesting toxic bacteria throughout its life.

abilityText.raw: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [Discard]

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Striated Frogfish
rawSource.ability: [FishEgg] also, if [PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral][PurpleCoral] in this dive site: [Discard]
rawSource.description: Called “hairy” for its soft spines, it has the fastest known fish bite (1/6000th of a second), swallowing prey whole.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Striped Eel Catfish
rawSource.description: The first dorsal and each of the pectoral fins have a highly venomous spine. Wounds may even be fatal to humans.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Swell Shark
rawSource.description: As a defense mechanism, this catshark is able to expand its body to twice its regular size by swallowing water.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Sydney's Pygmy Pipehorse
rawSource.description: Seahorses and pipefishes are very similar. There are also a few known species of pipehorses, which have attributes of both.

abilityText.raw: 5 [Wave] if [AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral] in ALL your dive sites

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Tasseled Scorpionfish
rawSource.ability: 5 [Wave] if [AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral] in ALL your dive sites
rawSource.description: The largest species in its genus, this ambush predator has vibrant markings that camouflage it between rocky reefs.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Tiger Shark
rawSource.description: The tiger shark is a solitary, nocturnal hunter. It has the widest range of prey among all sharks.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Tomato Clownfish
rawSource.description: A mucous coating lets it shelter inside an anemone, and, in turn, the anemone defends its home from parasites and predators.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Toothy Goby
rawSource.description: Its sucker-like pelvic fins allow the toothy goby to attach itself to soft corals (such as bubble coral) and sponges.

abilityText.raw: 3 [Wave] if [AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral] (in a dive site with at least 5)

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Variegated Lizardfish
rawSource.ability: 3 [Wave] if [AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral] (in a dive site with at least 5)
rawSource.description: An ambush predator, its vibrant markings camouflage it between rocky reefs where it waits, scanning for prey.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Velvet Belly Lanternshark
rawSource.description: Its black underside is not bioluminescent and is sharply delineated from the rest of its body like a patch of velvet.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Yellow Clown Goby
rawSource.description: Unlike most gobies, which are burrowers, these roost in groups of up to 15 in the outer branches of staghorn corals.

abilityText.raw: [FishFromHand][ArrowDown][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral] (in a dive site with at least 5)

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Yokozuna Slickhead
rawSource.ability: [FishFromHand][ArrowDown][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral][AnyCoral] (in a dive site with at least 5)
rawSource.description: “Yokozuna” is the highest rank of sumo wrestler. This slickhead is a top predator in Japan's abyssal Suruga Bay.

visual.backgroundAssetHint: base/blue/purple/green/GameEnd/IfActivated assets in manifest depending on card band/abilityTrigger

rawSource.name: Zebra Seahorse
rawSource.description: Seahorses are famously ovoviviparous. The male carries the fertilized eggs in a brood pouch situated under the tail.
